publisher: North Tyneside Council Planning Policy Team / public ArcGIS service
evidence_slice: North Tyneside Council's Supplementary planning documents and masterplans page states that masterplans and associated guidance have been produced for the Killingworth Moor and Murton Gap Strategic Sites, were formally agreed by Cabinet on 18 December 2017, and provide a framework for all future development on the sites. The public ArcGIS Strategic Sites feature layer published by the North Tyneside planning policy service is an esriGeometryPolygon layer described as two polygons representing Killingworth Moor and Murton Gap; its display field is SITE_NAME and its data last-edit date is 17 October 2025.

field_evidence.feature_layer_description: two polygons representing either Killingworth Moor or Murton Gap
field_evidence.masterplan_status: formally agreed by North Tyneside Council Cabinet on 18 December 2017
field_evidence.masterplan_role: framework for all future development on Killingworth Moor and Murton Gap Strategic Sites
